originalTitle: Inside Djibouti refugee camp for thousands fleeing Houthi advance in Yemen
summary: Fighting on Yemen's west coast has prompted thousands of people to flee by boat across the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
content:
Fighting on Yemen's west coast has prompted thousands of people to flee by boat across the Bab al-Mandab Strait to Djibouti over the last ten days.

The BBC's Frank Gardner visited a refugee camp in Obock, a small port town where officials are preparing for the arrival of up to 10,000 refugees.

The UN International Organisation for Migration said people were ​travelling on overcrowded boats and arriving with very limited food and water.

The crossings were sparked by an offensive by the Iran-backed Houthi movement to take control of a key island and seize the strategically important port of Mokha.
chineseTitle: 吉布提难民营内有数千名逃离也门胡塞武装的人
chineseSummary: 也门西海岸的战斗导致数千人乘船穿越曼德海峡逃离。
chineseContent:
过去十天，也门西海岸的战斗促使数千人乘船穿过曼德海峡逃往吉布提。

BBC 的弗兰克·加德纳 (Frank Gardner) 参观了奥博克 (Obock) 的一个难民营，这是一个港口小镇，官员们正在为迎接多达 10,000 名难民的到来做准备。

联合国国际移民组织表示，人们乘坐过度拥挤的船只，抵达时携带的食物和水非常有限。

这些过境点是由伊朗支持的胡塞运动发起的进攻引发的，目的是控制一个关键岛屿并夺取具有重要战略意义的港口莫卡。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
